title: Landing page: mobile/tablet/desktop responsive audit and polish
description:
Audit and tighten responsive behavior across the landing page and app so it feels native from a 320px phone up to 4K displays.

Scope:
- / (landing)
- /chat
- /workflows
- /workflows/[id]

Device targets (researched 2026 standards — Framer, Tailwind v4 defaults):
- Mobile portrait: 320-480px (iPhone SE through 14 Pro Max)
- Mobile landscape / small tablet: 481-768px
- Tablet: 769-1024px (iPad portrait)
- Small desktop: 1025-1280px
- Desktop: 1281-1536px
- Large desktop: 1537px+

Known landing page issues:
1. Hero grid gap-16 too large on narrow viewports — use gap-8 md:gap-16
2. FiveThings table grid-cols-[1fr_1.3fr] crammed on 320px — stack vertically
3. Hero demo Row component truncates on narrow screens
4. text-lg body copy borderline on 320px — use text-base sm:text-lg
5. py-24 section padding heavy on mobile — use py-16 sm:py-24
6. Channels grid — Google Chat description triple-wraps at 160px
7. Footer gap-5 links wrap awkwardly on small screens
8. No container queries used — add for hero demo and hosting cards
9. Test at 320, 375, 414, 768, 1024, 1280, 1536 in DevTools

Acceptance:
- No horizontal scroll at any target width
- Tap targets >=44px (iOS HIG)
- Body text >=16px without zoom
- No content clipping or overlap
- Tested in light and dark mode
- Verified on real iOS Safari and Android Chrome
